map.基于风险矩阵(概率x影响)对活动风险进行量化评估，涵盖安全风险、财务风险、声誉风: A quantified assessment of event risk based on a risk matrix (probability x impact), covering five categories - safety, financial, reputation, operational and legal compliance risk - automatically computing the risk level and giving response suggestions.
map.📖 查看「活动风险评估（概率/影响） 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Event Risk Assessment (Probability/Impact)'
map.活动单项风险值 = 发生概率（1 至 5 分）× 影响程度（1 至 5 分），取: Single event risk value = probability of occurrence (1 to 5 points) × degree of impact (1 to 5 points), ranging 1 to 25; the risk level is determined by the highest risk value: 16 or above is extreme risk, 10 to 15 is high risk, 5 to 9 is medium risk, and below 5 is low risk; items with a risk value of 10 or above must be included in the high-priority contingency plan list.
map.风险值=概率x影响，1-4低风险 5-9中风险 10-15高风险 16-25极高: Risk value = probability x impact, 1-4 low risk 5-9 medium risk 10-15 high risk 16-25 extreme risk
map.5. 法律合规风险-发生概率: 5. Legal compliance risk - probability of occurrence
map.5. 法律合规风险-影响程度: 5. Legal compliance risk - degree of impact
map.风险值=概率x影响，数值越高风险越大: Risk value = probability x impact, the higher the value the greater the risk
map.风险值10分以上的风险项需制定专项应急预案: Risk items scoring above 10 require a dedicated contingency plan
map.安全风险和法律合规风险无论评分高低都需重点关注: Safety risk and legal compliance risk need focused attention regardless of the score
map.建议活动前2周完成风险评估并报管理层审批: Complete the risk assessment 2 weeks before the event and submit it for management approval
map.大型活动筹备时，对安全、财务、声誉、运营、法律合规 5 类风险各估概率（1~5）: When planning a large event, estimate the probability (1-5) and impact (1-5) for each of the five risk categories - safety, financial, reputation, operational and legal compliance - and rank them by probability × impact.
map.横向比较 5 类风险，锁定风险值最高的一类优先制定预案。: Compare the five risk categories horizontally to lock onto the one with the highest risk value and write its contingency plan first.
map.把风险值 ≥10 的项计入「高风险项」，作为必须买保险/设应急岗的红线。: Count items with a risk value ≥10 as 'high-risk items', which are the red lines for mandatory insurance and emergency posts.
map.5 类风险（安全风险、财务风险、声誉风险、运营风险、法律合规风险），每类各填概率: 5 risk categories (safety risk, financial risk, reputation risk, operational risk, legal compliance risk), each filled with a probability (1-5) and an impact (1-5); risk value = probability × impact; the highest risk value takes the maximum of the five. Levels: highest risk value ≥16 extreme risk, ≥10 high risk, ≥5 medium risk, <5 low risk; items with a risk value ≥10 count as 'high-risk items'.
map.某音乐节：安全(5,5)=25、财务(4,3)=12、声誉(3,4)=12、运营: A music festival: safety(5,5)=25, financial(4,3)=12, reputation(3,4)=12, operational(4,3)=12, legal(2,3)=6 → the highest 25 is judged extreme risk, with 4 high-risk items (safety/financial/reputation/operational), requiring cancellation or major adjustment. By contrast, an internal training session: safety(3,3)=9, financial(2,2)=4, reputation(3,2)=6, operational(2,3)=6, legal(2,2)=4 → the highest 9 is judged medium risk, with 0 high-risk items, so a standard contingency plan suffices.
map.概率和影响都填 5 分风险值 25，是不是直接取消活动？: If both probability and impact are 5 giving a risk value of 25, should the event be cancelled outright?
map.风险值 25 触发「极高风险、建议取消或重大调整」的提示，但是否取消还要看该风险: A risk value of 25 triggers the 'extreme risk, cancellation or major adjustment recommended' notice, but whether to cancel also depends on whether the risk can be mitigated - for example a safety risk (5,5) can have its probability pushed down to 2 through capacity limits, security screening and on-site medical staff, bringing the risk value down to 10. This tool gives the 'risk level without intervention', which drives the contingency plan rather than acting as a single veto.
map.为什么用 概率×影响 而不是相加？: Why multiply probability × impact instead of adding them?
map.相乘能区分「高概率低影响」与「低概率高影响」——两者相加可能相同，但后者一旦触发: Multiplication distinguishes 'high probability low impact' from 'low probability high impact' - the two may be equal when added, but the latter has severe consequences once triggered. Multiplication gives 'extreme impact' inherently higher weight, which is closer to risk management common sense (such as tail catastrophe events). If your system prefers addition, you can use the result as a reference and compute separately.
map.活动风险评估工具基于风险矩阵(概率x影响)对活动5大类风险进行量化评估，自动计算: The event risk assessment tool quantifies the five categories of event risk based on a risk matrix (probability x impact), automatically computing the risk value and level of each item, helping event teams identify high-risk items and formulate contingency plans.
